A '''darter''' was a short-ranged large pistol that launched a dart via compressed air. It caused minimal damage, but could be used to deliver a [[Surveillance tagger/Legends|surveillance tagger]] or [[Poison/Legends|poison]]. Hunters, medical personnel, assassins and security personnel were known to use them.
